svg.aria-label: End-to-end pipeline: a claim is submitted through Streamlit and FastAPI, runs through six agents and a deterministic router in LangGraph. The rules-based Policy agent and the RAG-based PolicyRAG agent must agree. Every step is validated, retried once, audited and saved. The router sends the claim to human review, reject or auto-approve.
svg.text: Insurance Claims Multi-Agent Harness — end-to-end pipeline
Models describe, code decides. Every hand-off between agents is a validated Pydantic object.

g.text: JPEG/PNG ≤10 MB · date not in future
Every agent runs through run_agent() in app/agents.py
1) validate output with Pydantic (extra = forbid) · 2) bad output → retry once · 3) second failure → claim goes to human review
4) write an AuditEntry: agent, status, input, output, note, time · 5) save the whole ClaimState to disk after every step
agent failure · missing data · rules ≠ RAG · photo ≠ story · confidence < 0.7 · risk ≥ 0.6 · net > $5,000
policy inactive · peril not in the package · exclusion hit · reported too late (clauses cited)
covered, rules and RAG agree, low risk, photo matches, payout within limit
30 synthetic claims (expected labels never shown to agents) → process_claim() → check routing · reasons · payout · citations · rules/RAG agreement · photo/story mismatch · failures → reports/
